turns.text: Hello, I need help with my electricity bill payment.
Namaste! Sure, main aapki madad kar sakta hoon. Kya aap apna customer ID bata sakte hain?
Customer BK-82413 found. Balance due ₹2,340, due date 2026-12-01, last payment window ends 5 pm today.
Dhanyavad! Aapka customer ID BK-82413 ke liye current balance ₹2,340 hai, jo aaj 5 pm tak pay karna hai. Kya main payment process karoon?
Haan, process karo please. Confirm karo.
Payment of ₹2,340 initiated for BK-82413. Status: success, transaction ref TX-55120.
Ho gaya! Aapka account BK-82413 ke liye payment ₹2,340 ka successfully process ho gaya, transaction reference TX-55120. Kuch aur?
